full_text:
Nikola Tesla was a scientist and engineer who was born in Serbia during the nineteenth century. In addition, Tesla was a Seeker.

== History ==
Nikola Tesla set a Sentry Triclops Titan to guard his workshop. At some point, Zhalia Moon attempted to gain entrance to this workshop and was confronted with the Titan that was still guarding the place. [The Tower of Nostradamus]

== Abilities ==
Nikola Tesla had access to an Amulet of a powerful Titan known as Sentry Triclops. [The Tower of Nostradamus] The full extent of his abilities, however, remains unknown.

=== Titans Bonded ===
* Sentry Triclops
